name.zh-Hant: 金德代克-埃爾斯豪特風車群
name.zh-Hans: 金德代克-埃尔斯豪特风车群

airspace.zh: 荷蘭政府：開放類無人機不能飛越政府建築、軍事設施、鐵路與機場周邊；部分 Natura 2000 區域由省或土地管理者決定禁飛，金德代克的蓄水池正屬於 Natura 2000。實際飛行前請查 GoDrone 地圖（map.godrone.nl）並依規定辦理。
airspace.en: Dutch government: open-category drones may not fly over government buildings, military sites, railways or around airports, and some Natura 2000 sites are closed by the province or land manager — the Kinderdijk reservoirs are a Natura 2000 site. Before any real flight, check the GoDrone map (map.godrone.nl) and follow the rules.

site.zh: 金德代克-埃爾斯豪特風車群

tagline.zh-Hant: 從挖溝渠到風車，再到抽水站
tagline.en: From ditches to windmills to pumping stations

zh: 這裡是荷蘭南荷蘭省的金德代克，
十九座風車排成兩列，守著低地。
en: This is Kinderdijk, in the Dutch province of South Holland,
where nineteen windmills stand in rows over the lowland.

zh: 為了排乾土地來耕種與居住，
這裡從中世紀就開始興建水利工程，一直延續到今天。
en: Works to drain the land for farming and settlement began here in the Middle Ages
and have gone on to this day.

zh: 這片低地叫阿布拉瑟瓦德，
十到十三世紀間被開墾出來。
en: This lowland is the Alblasserwaard,
reclaimed between the tenth and the thirteenth centuries.

zh: 十三世紀，積水問題越來越明顯；
人們挖了大渠道，把多餘的水排出去。
en: By the thirteenth century the water was a growing problem;
large canals were dug to carry the surplus away.

zh: 1277年，荷蘭伯爵弗洛里斯五世成立水利機構，
沿著整片低地築起一圈環形堤防。
en: In 1277 Count Floris V set up a water authority
that ringed the whole lowland with a dike.

zh: 但排乾的土地不斷下沉，
河床卻因泥沙堆積而升高。
en: But the drained ground kept sinking,
while the river rose with the sand it laid down.

zh: 1365年與1369年，兩大排水系統都改道到金德代克；
這兩座下層蓄水池保存至今。
en: In 1365 and 1369 the two great drainage systems were moved to Kinderdijk;
their lower reservoirs survive today.

zh: 到了1738年，內德瓦德的八座風車建成；
1740年，歐弗瓦德的八座也完工。
en: In 1738 the eight Nederwaard mills were built,
and in 1740 the eight of the Overwaard.

zh: 1860年代，這裡蓋了兩座蒸汽抽水站；
維斯博姆抽水站負責歐弗瓦德。
en: In the 1860s two steam pumping stations were built here;
the Wisboom station served the Overwaard.

zh: 1924年，維斯博姆抽水站從蒸汽改成電力。
en: In 1924 the Wisboom station changed from steam to electricity.

zh: 二次大戰時燃料短缺，
水利單位只好再靠風車抽水。
en: In the Second World War, fuel ran short
and the water board had to pump with the wind again.

zh: 戰後，抽水工作全部交給抽水站；
風車停用，甚至一度被認真考慮拆除。
en: After the war the pumping stations took over completely;
the mills fell idle, and demolishing them was seriously considered.

zh: 1997年，風車群列入世界遺產。
十九座風車至今仍能運轉，是現代設備故障時的備援。
en: In 1997 the mill network became World Heritage.
All nineteen mills still work, as a fall-back if the modern pumps fail.

zh: 近一千年的排水與守護，
都寫在這片地景裡。
en: Nearly a thousand years of draining and defending the land
are written into this landscape.

title.en: A Cradle, the Mills and Their Millers

tagline.zh-Hant: 名字的傳說，與守住風車的人
tagline.en: The legend of the name, and the people who kept the mills

zh: 金德代克的意思是「孩子的堤防」。
名字來自一個流傳很廣的故事。
en: Kinderdijk means "children's dike".
The name comes from a story that is often told.

zh: 1421年11月18日夜裡，一場暴風雨
讓北海沿岸的堤防多處潰決。
en: On the night of 18 November 1421 a great storm
broke the dikes in many places near the North Sea coast.

zh: 這場聖伊莉莎白洪水淹沒了大荷蘭瓦德，
許多村莊從此消失。
en: The St. Elizabeth's flood drowned the Grote Hollandse Waard,
and many villages were lost for good.

zh: 傳說洪水退後，有人在堤防上看見一個木搖籃漂來；
一隻貓在上面跳來跳去，讓搖籃保持平衡。
en: The story goes that after the flood a wooden cradle drifted up to the dike,
a cat leaping from side to side to keep it level.

zh: 搖籃靠岸後，裡面的嬰兒睡得正熟，身上一點也沒濕。
這個故事後來以《貓與搖籃》流傳。
en: When it came ashore, the baby inside was fast asleep and quite dry.
The tale is known in English as "The Cat and the Cradle".

zh: 內德瓦德的八座磚造風車，
因為由不同的承包商建造，細節各有不同。
en: The eight brick mills of the Nederwaard
differ in their details, as different contractors built them.

zh: 每一座風車裡，
都住著磨坊主人一家人。
en: In each of these mills
lived a miller and his family.

zh: 後來內德瓦德改用柴油抽水站，風車停用，
但磨坊主人和家人仍可以住在裡面。
en: When the Nederwaard turned to a diesel pumping station and its mills stopped,
the millers and their families were allowed to stay.

zh: 1993年，這一帶被劃為受保護的村落景觀。
en: In 1993 the area became a protected village landscape.

zh: 2008年，十九座中的十一座開始整修；
依照風車建造當年的工法進行。
en: In 2008 eleven of the nineteen mills began to be restored,
with the techniques of the time they were built.

zh: 維斯博姆抽水站在2011年整修後，
成為遊客中心。
en: The Wisboom pumping station was refurbished in 2011
and opened as a visitors' centre.

zh: 兩列風車之間，只能步行或騎腳踏車參觀；
有三座風車開放遊客入內。
en: The rows of mills are best seen on foot or by bicycle;
three of them are open to visitors.

zh: 金德代克世界遺產基金會，
自2005年起承租十九座風車，負責管理。
en: The Kinderdijk World Heritage Foundation
has leased and managed the nineteen mills since 2005.

zh: 一個搖籃的傳說，
和一代代守著風車的人，留下了這個地方的名字與樣子。
en: A legend about a cradle,
and the generations who kept the mills, gave this place its name and its look.

zh: 風車群所在的地方，
同時也是一座受保護的自然保留區。
en: The ground the mills stand on
is also a protected nature reserve.

zh: 金德代克的蓄水池屬於歐洲的自然保護網絡「Natura 2000」，
也受歐盟野鳥保護指令保護。
en: The Kinderdijk reservoirs belong to Europe's Natura 2000 network
and are covered by the EU directive on wild birds.

zh: 這套水利系統，讓人們能在大片泥炭地上定居與耕作。
en: This water system made it possible to settle and farm a large area of peat land.

zh: 土地排乾後會慢慢下沉；
所有的圩田，最後都會低於周圍的水面。
en: Drained land slowly sinks;
in the end every polder lies below the water around it.

zh: 雨水與地下水不斷滲進低地，
所以圩田總是有多餘的水要排出去。
en: Rain and groundwater keep seeping into the low land,
so a polder always has water to get rid of.

zh: 從上面看，一條條水道把田地切成長條；
高低兩層的排水道，把水一路送往河邊。
en: From above, waterways cut the fields into long strips;
high and low channels carry the water on towards the river.

zh: 風車需要風。
省政府規定，風車周圍四百公尺內，建築與樹木的高度都受限制。
en: A windmill needs wind.
The province limits the height of buildings and trees within 400 metres of the mills.

zh: 這個範圍叫做「風車生態圈」，
讓風車一直吹得到風，也一直看得見。
en: This zone is called the mill biotope:
it keeps the mills in the wind and in view.

zh: 新萊克爾蘭的低風車建於1761年；
旁邊的高風車建於1740年。
en: The Lage Molen of Nieuw-Lekkerland was built in 1761,
and the Hoge Molen nearby in 1740.

zh: 兩座都是蓋在磚牆上的八角形茅草風車。
en: Both are thatched octagonal mills on brick bases.

zh: 在新萊克爾蘭的鄉村分區計畫裡，大部分土地是自然保護區：
不准蓋房子，挖土也要先取得許可。
en: In the rural zoning plan of Nieuw-Lekkerland most of the land is a nature conservation area:
no building is allowed, and earth may be moved only with a permit.

zh: 水與堤防的管理，
交給河川地區水利委員會。
en: The water and the dikes
are in the care of the Rivierenland Water Board.

zh: 水平的運河、堤防與田地，
和直立的風車形成鮮明的節奏。
en: The level lines of canals, dikes and fields
meet the upright rhythm of the mills.

zh: 水、風與泥炭地，
在這裡一起被照顧了好幾百年。
en: Water, wind and peat
have been looked after together here for centuries.

tagline.en: Lifting water one point four metres

zh: 金德代克在鹿特丹以東約十五公里，
萊克河與諾德河在這裡交會。
en: Kinderdijk lies about 15 km east of Rotterdam,
where the Lek and the Noord rivers meet.

zh: 風車群位在阿布拉瑟瓦德圩田的西北角。
en: The mills stand in the north-west corner of the Alblasserwaard polder.

zh: 這裡是荷蘭現存最集中的一群老風車。
en: This is the largest group of old windmills in the Netherlands.

zh: 十九座排水風車、三座抽水站、兩座排水閘門，
還有兩棟水利委員會的議事廳。
en: Nineteen drainage mills, three pumping stations, two discharge sluices
and two Water Board assembly houses.

zh: 風車分三種：八座圓形磚造的「地帆風車」，
十座八角形茅草罩衫風車，還有一座空心柱式風車。
en: The mills come in three kinds: eight round brick ground-sailers,
ten thatched octagonal smock mills and one hollow post mill.

zh: 罩衫風車的名字，
來自它像農夫穿的罩衫；頂蓋會轉動，讓風帆迎風。
en: The smock mill takes its name from the smock farmers once wore;
its cap turns to bring the sails into the wind.

zh: 歐弗瓦德風車的風帆展開約二十九公尺，
底下的刮水輪直徑六點七公尺。
en: The Overwaard mills have sails about 29 metres across,
and a scoop wheel 6.7 metres in diameter.

zh: 每座風車能把水抬高約一點四公尺。
en: Each mill can lift water about 1.4 metres.

zh: 抽水分兩段：先從圩田抽進中間高度的蓄水池，
等河水夠低時，再排進河裡。
en: Pumping comes in two steps: from the polder into a reservoir at an in-between level,
then into the river whenever the river is low enough.

zh: 河的水位會隨季節與潮汐起落。
en: The river rises and falls with the seasons and the tides.

zh: 布洛克是這裡唯一的空心柱式風車，建於1630年。
en: De Blokker is the only hollow post mill here, built in 1630.

zh: 1997年它被大火嚴重燒毀，
修復後在2001年重新運轉。
en: A fire badly damaged it in 1997;
restored, it has worked again since 2001.

zh: 兩條排水道在這裡平行，
中間只隔著一道窄窄的堤岸步道。
en: The two drainage channels run side by side here,
parted only by a narrow embankment path.

zh: 把水抬高一點四公尺，
就讓一整片低地住得了人。
en: Lifting water by one point four metres
is what keeps a whole lowland fit to live in.
